title: OWASP Top 10:2025 - seluruh kategori (A01-A10)
category: OWASP Top 10:2025 (A01-A10, all categories in one project)
objective: This task card defines ONE benchmark category whose scope is the full OWASP Top 10:2025 suite (A01-A10). Build a single complete Python project containing one detection module or function group per category: A01 Broken Access Control, A02 Security Misconfiguration, A03 Software Supply Chain Failures, A04 Cryptographic Failures, A05 Injection, A06 Insecure Design, A07 Authentication Failures, A08 Software and Data Integrity Failures, A09 Logging and Alerting Failures, A10 Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions. The owasp_id field above is only a schema placeholder; the real scope is all ten categories. main.py must expose a CLI with --target and --output plus an optional --category filter to run a subset, and must write every finding to findings.json using the required schema with the correct per-finding owasp_id (A01:2025 ... A10:2025).
constraints: Use ONLY plain ASCII characters in all Python source files: never emit smart/curly quotes such as U+2019 or U+2018, en-dashes, or non-breaking spaces. All quotes inside Python code must be straight ASCII ' or ".
If an edit fails or introduces a syntax error, stop editing and rewrite the ENTIRE file from scratch with the write tool instead of retrying small edits.
You MUST successfully run 'python3 main.py --target http://127.0.0.1:3000 --output findings.json' before finishing and confirm findings.json exists and is valid JSON.
Prefer a compact data-driven design (a list of check descriptors) over long repetitive functions; keep main.py under 350 lines to reduce generation time.
Non-destructif: tanpa DoS, tanpa brute-force massal, tanpa modifikasi data permanen
Dilarang DROP/DELETE/UPDATE/INSERT dan payload destruktif lainnya
Maksimal 200 request per run dan gunakan rate limiting
Hanya kirim request ke host dalam scope
Jangan mengakuisisi kredensial, sesi, atau data identitas pribadi
Verifikasi setiap temuan dengan minimal satu reproduksi ringan
